source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Rhus aromatica Aiton var. serotina (Greene) Rehder

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub to ca. 2 m, creeping stem bases forming loose clumps
morphology_documented.leaves: Palmately 3-foliate; terminal leaflet 25–60 mm long, narrowed and often pointed at apex; leaflets usually pubescent below and margins usually ciliate; fragrant when bruised
morphology_documented.flowers: Terminal dense head-like or irregular clusters; yellow petals; flowering before leaves or with unfolding leaves

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Infraspecific original flora identification is var. serotina; rank/concept reconciliation needed
Flora key compares R. trilobata, whose terminal leaflet is usually 15–33 mm long and abruptly narrowed or truncate
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
